instruction: Enable Windows Mouse Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled throughout the task. On the Reddit website, search for the post titled "How do I vote?". Read the comments and open every website link mentioned in the comments in separate new Chrome tabs. Leave both website tabs open and leave Mouse Keys enabled.
gt_steps: Keep Mouse Keys enabled throughout the task.
Open the Reddit website in Chrome.
Use the Reddit search bar to search for `How do I vote?`.
Open the post titled `How do I vote?`.
Read the comments under the post.
Open the first link in a new Chrome tab.
Open the second link in another new Chrome tab.
Leave both linked website tabs open.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags=[int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\MouseKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_DISABLED' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$tabs=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:9222/json'; $urls=$tabs | ForEach-Object { $_.url }; if ($urls -contains 'https://vote.sos.ri.gov/Home/UpdateVoterRecord?ActiveFlag=0') { Write-Output 'VOTER_RECORD_LINK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'VOTER_RECORD_LINK_MISSING' }; if (($urls -contains 'https://vote.sos.ri.gov/') -or ($urls -contains 'https://vote.sos.ri.gov')) { Write-Output 'VOTING_HOME_LINK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'VOTING_HOME_LINK_MISSING' }"
